Definition: Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah
BiblicalUsage: Zimran is the eldest son of Abraham by Keturah, named first among the sons of the second marriage. He has no story of his own — only a name in the genealogy, repeated in the Chronicler's record. His full story lives on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sons of Keturah remind me that God's promise ran through Isaac, yet Abraham's other sons were still named and still counted.
